content.title: About
content.content: Dessert sauce (5050) is a thick sweet sauce made from fruit purées, sugar and natural flavorings. It is intended for drizzling over cakes, ice cream, pancakes and other desserts, giving them a vivid fruit taste and a glossy finish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sauce is produced in small batches to preserve the freshness and aroma of the fruits.
Only natural ingredients are used, without artificial colors or preservatives.
5050 indicates the balance of sweetness and acidity (50 % sugar, 50 % fruit).
The sauce can serve as a base for creating custom fruit glazes and jams.
It keeps in the refrigerator for up to 6 months after opening if tightly sealed.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Fruit components provide vitamin C, which supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Unlike creamy sauces, the dessert sauce contains virtually no fat, making it a lighter option.

items.title: Source of natural sugars
items.content: The sugar comes from fruit, offering a slower rise in blood glucose compared with refined sugar.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Small amounts of fruit fiber help maintain normal bowel function.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: People allergic to specific fruits (e.g., strawberry or mango) should check the ingredient list.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Despite being natural, the sauce contains a notable amount of sugar and should be limited for individuals with diabetes.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the sauce refrigerated and use within 2‑3 weeks to prevent microbial growth.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle the sauce over a finished cake, ice cream, pancakes or waffles. It can also be stirred into yogurt, cottage cheese, or used as a filling for layered desserts. For a thinner consistency, dilute with a small amount of water or juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place. After opening, keep it refrigerated at 0 °C–4 °C, tightly sealed. Discard the product if it develops a fermented smell or changes color.
